source_family: Independent generated episode root; all members and transitions stay with their root. These are synthetic roots, not natural source provenance.
encoder: Frozen 8-dimensional one-hot shared encoder; no pretrained neural Encoder available
mechanism: Two hidden categorical members compose as (a+b) mod 8. Relation feature is cyclic convolution, explicitly privileged task-aligned inductive bias; no general reasoning claim.
logical_depth: budget/4 edges (2 or 4), plus terminal retrieval; remaining calls permit verification and backtracking. 8/16 action cap is NOT 8/16 semantic depth.
search_cost: retrieve, verifier, and backtrack are individually charged; verifier computes 8 candidates in one call and records 8 candidate evaluations; failed branches and exhausted trajectories retained
noise: Verifier estimates have seeded Gaussian noise with edge-specific sigma in [0.1,0.8]; risk coefficient 0.25, ablated to 0. No learned uncertainty guarantee.
selection: No holdout-based selection or tuning; all methods/seeds/ablations reported
risk: abstain if no terminal reached; coverage=answered/all, selective risk=wrong/answered, abstentions count as failures in accuracy; calibrated head threshold is 80th percentile development confidence fixed before holdout
comparison: Paired episode/source-root bootstrap 2000 draws, 95% CI; report every seed, pooled results exploratory. Mechanism supported only if paired gain lower bound >0, corruption reduces gain, permutation invariant, and matched actual cost comparisons agree. Otherwise inconclusive/negative.
natural_followup: QASC CC BY 4.0 official train split internally into fit/development/calibration; freeze before reading official 926 dev. Preserve 8 choices, random 12.5%, train-majority and answer-only.
